audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 read Skill and Level 6 read Ziggs; the mirror settled the opposite on both rows.
audit.why: The mirror (gragas__ziggs) fixed the chart as Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Ziggs and proposed the two flips as one group. Levels 4-5 are yours because you hold Satchel Charge for Body Slam; Level 6 is the coin-flip because Explosive Cask arrives and can fling you into his tower.
audit.corrected: phases[3]/win[3] to Ziggs and phases[4]/win[4] to Skill, both layers, one atomic group, ratings swapped to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was described as your Mega Inferno Bomb spike with no numbers anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Explosive Cask is 100/85/70s at 1000 range, Body Slam 14s falling to 12s at 600, Barrel Roll 10s to 6s at 850 for 80 mana, Drunken Rage a flat 5s. Your Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1, Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s, Mega Inferno Bomb 120s.
audit.corrected: Level 6 now names the Body Slam into Explosive Cask fling with its real timers, and the mid text dates Satchel Charge against Body Slam.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two claims: that Bouncing Bomb out-ranges his poke, and that his sustain 'doesn't matter'. Neither holds.
audit.why: Barrel Roll is 850 range — identical to Bouncing Bomb, so nobody out-ranges anybody and the exchange is decided by the mana bar and the dodge, not by reach. His sustain is Happy Hour, which heals periodically on every ability use, which is exactly what makes Grievous Wounds timing decide extended trades. Drunken Rage is also an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up precedes the burst.
audit.corrected: Range parity stated, Happy Hour named with the anti-heal requirement, and the Drunken Rage reset added as the burst tell.
